scope: canonical admission of the restricted sensible-soil-temperature capability only

invariants.basis: capability joins the existing canonical kernel contracts and does not create a second SWAP kernel
admitted modules contain no file, path, parser, unit or format ownership
parameters, state, forcing, numerical configuration, results and diagnostics remain explicit distinct data types
persistent continuation state contains only active-node temperature; immutable material and geometry data remain parameters
constitutive vectors and linear-solve arrays remain workspace scratch rather than column state
compact state and reusable scratch are compatible with scalable layouts; measured batch throughput is not claimed
trial state is separate from committed state and commit is explicit; immutability is independently replayed
minimal restart reconstruction and split-run identity are independently replayed
process operates on generic t0,t1 without day, month, year or midnight assumptions
no coupling-window duration is introduced
groundwater coupling ownership and transaction composition are not changed
groundwater head/flux interface is untouched
hydraulic water content is read-only; no water storage/source/sink is introduced; sensible-energy closure is mandatory and qualified
groundwater interface sensitivity transport is untouched
no coupling rerun path or additional groundwater solve is introduced
interleaved logical columns reproduce isolated results; throughput scaling remains a separate qualification
MODFLOW tile fractions remain runtime/coupler ownership
deep-vadose design is untouched
deep-vadose transition storage is untouched
thermal process consumes the common hydraulic view and is not coupled to one Richards implementation
De Vries sensible-heat physics is reused without legacy global-state or I/O ownership
only the semantic process hydraulic view is consumed; no HeadCalc internals are visible
restricted physical scope and numerical energy tolerance are explicit and separate
thermal step uses bounded O(n) tridiagonal work; difficult-column runtime/fallback behavior is not claimed
full independent qualification remains available against the frozen restricted reference route; broader thermal physics remains held
status, counts, boundary markers and energy diagnostics remain explicit outputs
thermal state and scratch exist only when the capability is instantiated; frost and snow state are not added
admitted process has no knowledge of MODFLOW tiles, surface fractions or deep-vadose composition
no hidden file, midnight, one-day or direct-MODFLOW assumption is introduced
F-CI43 explicitly re-audits all 30 invariants and records non-applicable and structural-only cases instead of blanket PASS claims

admission_limit: Canonical source admission does not itself compose the capability into the production runtime call graph and does not qualify frost, snow, latent heat, alternative boundary modes or large-batch throughput.
